notes.subject: צלמות
notes.rationale: 'Shadow of death' vs 'deep darkness' — many read צלמות as a superlative intensification of צל 'shade', i.e. 'deepest gloom', without death.

notes.subject: gmajna
notes.rationale: גיא is a gorge/valley with lofty sides; 'gmajna' is the Slovene upland word for a deep valley common in the Soča region.

notes.subject: palica
notes.rationale: שבט is a rod — for punishing, ruling, walking; shepherd's club, one Hebrew word.

notes.subject: Jahve
notes.rationale: The psalm shifts from speaking about Jahve (3rd person, vv. 2–3) to addressing him directly (2nd person) here.

translation: Tudi ko hodim skozi senco smrti ⟨gmajno⟩, se ne bojem hudega, ker ti si ⟨z⟩ menoj; tvoja palica in tvoja opora — one me tolažijo.
